scenarios.name: Inspect the panel selector with a custom panel present

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target
a User Commands panel is visible on Tools
the user opens the direct ribbon panel selector
the selector lists Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find, Team Web, and Tutorials
the selector does not list User Commands
the User Commands panel remains visible on the ribbon
the user opens Customize from Tools
the user removes 2D Sketches from the Part Tools target
the User Commands panel is removed
